# Bucks County Bicycle Garage

> Independent, home-based bicycle repair and service in Yardley / Lower Makefield, Pennsylvania, serving surrounding Lower Bucks County.

Bucks County Bicycle Garage (BCBG) is a residential bicycle garage workshop, not a walk-in retail storefront. Service is by appointment. Scheduled bicycle drop-off is available, along with pickup and delivery depending on location and schedule.

## Services

- Bicycle repair and maintenance
- Standard bicycle tune-up: $85
- Flat tire, tube and tire service
- Brake adjustment and related service
- Derailleur tuning, shifting and drivetrain service
- Wheel truing, tire setup and tubeless work
- Bike assembly and setup
- Bicycle rack and accessory installation
- Bicycle packing for travel or shipping
- Mechanical service for many e-bikes; contact BCBG first for electrical or drive-system issues

## Service area

- Yardley, Pennsylvania
- Lower Makefield Township, Pennsylvania
- Surrounding Lower Bucks County, Pennsylvania

## Contact

- Website: https://buckscountybicyclegarage.com/
- Phone / text: 267-373-1184
- Email: buckscountybicyclegarage@gmail.com
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/sCggLEzTykWhUMoh6

Texting is often the easiest way to start a service request. Service and bicycle drop-off are scheduled by appointment.
